title: How to Protect COD Orders on Shopify India — EscaraPay Integration Guide 2026
excerpt: Getting too many fake COD orders on your Shopify store? Set up EscaraPay in 15 minutes — every COD order gets automatically protected and fake buyers are filtered out before you dispatch.
metaDescription: Step-by-step guide to protect Shopify COD orders with EscaraPay. Stop RTO losses, filter fake buyers, and auto-verify every customer. Free setup for Indian sellers 2026.

content.text: If you are selling on Shopify India and losing 30-40% of your revenue to COD returns and fake orders — this guide is written specifically for you. Connect EscaraPay to your Shopify store in 15 minutes and stop fake COD orders permanently.
The Biggest Problem with Shopify COD — Fake Orders

Shopify is a powerful platform for Indian sellers. But one problem affects every Shopify seller using COD: fake and fraudulent orders. A buyer places an order, you dispatch the product, and then it comes back — wasting your product cost, shipping charges, and valuable time.

items.title: RTO (Return to Origin) Loss
items.desc: Buyer places a COD order but refuses delivery or does not answer the phone. The product comes back and you lose double the shipping cost plus your margin.

items.title: Fake Address Orders
items.desc: Many buyers enter incomplete or wrong addresses. Delivery fails before it even reaches them, and the courier returns the package — charging you both ways.

items.title: Impulse Orders
items.desc: COD requires no upfront payment, so buyers order impulsively and cancel later. This blocks your inventory and kills your conversion metrics.

content.text: How EscaraPay Solves This — Token Before Dispatch

EscaraPay uses a token-based payment system. When a buyer places a COD order, EscaraPay automatically collects a small token amount (10% of the order value) from the buyer before you dispatch. This token acts as proof that the buyer is genuine and serious about receiving their order. Only buyers who pay the token get their order dispatched.

How much is the token? The default is 10% — just Rs 100 on a Rs 1,000 order. This amount is low enough that genuine buyers pay it instantly, but high enough to filter out fake and impulsive buyers completely.

items.title: Step 1 — Create Your EscaraPay Seller Account
items.desc: Visit escarapay.in, click Register as Seller, fill in your PAN or GST details, add your shop name, and your account is ready. It is completely free.

items.title: Step 2 — Generate Your API Key
items.desc: Go to Seller Dashboard, click the Integration tab, then click Generate API Key. You will receive a unique key like ep_live_abc123. Copy and save it in a secure place.

items.title: Step 3 — Set Up the Shopify Webhook
items.desc: In Shopify Admin, go to Settings, then Notifications, scroll down to Webhooks, and click Create Webhook. Set Event to Order Creation, Format to JSON, and paste the Webhook URL from your EscaraPay Integration tab. Save.

items.title: Step 4 — Add the Trust Badge (Recommended)
items.desc: In Shopify Admin, go to Online Store, then Themes, click Edit Code, open theme.liquid, and paste this line before the closing body tag: script src='https://escarapay.in/sdk/escara.js' data-seller-id='YOUR_ID'. Save.

items.title: Step 5 — Place a Test Order
items.desc: Place a test COD order on your Shopify store. Check your EscaraPay dashboard — the order should appear. The buyer's email should receive a token payment link. Setup is complete.

content.text: What Happens After Integration — The Complete Flow

items: Buyer places a COD order on your Shopify store
Shopify automatically sends the order details to EscaraPay
EscaraPay instantly emails the buyer a token payment link
Order appears in your EscaraPay dashboard with status Pending Token
Buyer pays the token — status changes to Token Paid
You dispatch the order from Shopify
EscaraPay sends the buyer a delivery confirmation link
Buyer confirms delivery — payment is released to your UPI
If buyer takes no action within 14 days — payment auto-releases to you

content.text: Prepaid orders are completely skipped — EscaraPay only processes COD orders. Orders paid via Razorpay, PayTM, or UPI are automatically ignored. No extra setup needed.
Real Results — What Shopify Sellers Experience

items.title: 60-70% Reduction in RTO Rate
items.desc: Buyers who pay a token are genuine. They have already committed to receiving the order. Fake and impulsive buyers naturally filter themselves out.

items.title: Better Cash Flow
items.desc: Token is collected before dispatch. Even if delivery fails for any reason, you have partial recovery and proof of buyer commitment.

items.title: Zero Extra Work After Setup
items.desc: Once configured, everything runs automatically. Just check your dashboard for Token Paid orders and dispatch with confidence.

items.title: Is EscaraPay officially compatible with Shopify?
items.desc: Yes. EscaraPay uses Shopify Webhooks, which is an official Shopify feature. No third-party app installation is required.

items.title: How long does the setup take?
items.desc: The complete setup takes 15 to 20 minutes. No coding knowledge is required.

items.title: Will buyers know about EscaraPay?
items.desc: Yes. The payment page shows Powered by EscaraPay and the checkout page shows a trust badge. This actually increases buyer confidence.

items.title: What commission does EscaraPay charge?
items.desc: EscaraPay charges 5% commission on successful delivery. The payment gateway fee of approximately 2% is charged to the buyer.

content.text: Shopify combined with EscaraPay makes your COD business significantly more profitable. No more fear of fake orders, reduced RTO loss, and only genuine buyers in your pipeline. Set it up today — it is free to start!
